stefan.renderer: Stefan fill_kb_prompt; format premise and hypothesis

classification_order: Any Lim status: UNKNOWN (-), even if a proof is closed
Both Ter and both closed: UNKNOWN (-), reason inconsistent; separate report category
Both Ter and exactly one closed: entailment/contradiction according to the closed proof
Both Ter and both open: neutral
common_adapter_deviations_from_july.comparability: Common interpretation/feedback correction in both new arms; not an exact replay of unmodified July or September runs
common_adapter_deviations_from_july.critic_feedback: When trace.pred is '-', closure formatter returns 'unknown (incomplete or conflicting proofs)' instead of claiming neutral; critic template unchanged
common_adapter_deviations_from_july.proof_status_validation: Both proof info arrays must contain at least 3 entries; info[1] must be open/closed and info[2] must fully match (Ter|Lim)\d*. Missing/malformed status is a technical error
common_adapter_deviations_from_july.purpose: Keep unknown, technical errors and neutral distinct in both arms

execution.agentic: Same initial phases as one-shot, then at most one Stefan critic and refinement; no critic_stop adapter
execution.baseline_policy: Baseline per ID and WN condition with complete raw response; no label-only reuse
execution.denominators: 1000 fixed for every model/prompt/configuration; semantic coverage separately
execution.eligibility: July/pilot: generate only when baseline is neutral and incorrect; correct/error/other predictions stop
execution.one_shot: At most one KB generation; result from the shared baseline and initial generation/proof phases
execution.refinement_sharing: Only same input, whole request, attempt, parser and WN condition; initial prompt is WN-independent
execution.sharing: WN on/off baseline requests globally shared; initial per model/prompt shared across WN; one-shot derived from first shared attempt; critic/refinement only exact phase context
execution.source_limit: New pilot-derived protocol, not a certified replay of historical September exports
execution.unknown_policy: Lim => unknown; malformed => technical_error; both closed => inconsistent; both Ter open => neutral
execution.scheduling: One model at a time ascending frozen estimated total cost; concurrent independent problems
execution.cache_key_policy: LangPro: effective text, normalized effective KB, endpoint/parser/RAL/senses/flags/backend/interpretation version. Exclude model,prompt,ID,gold. LLM: complete request,model,all effective params,phase,parser,context.
execution.stop_policy: STOP prevents new sends; drain active calls; uncertain remote requests retain global lock, never automatically resend

filtering.profile: July Stefan/pilot; original+all-verb lemma+diff-only+inverse then strict filter

llm.max_iterations_meaning: Initial KB generation plus at most one refinement
llm.omitted_parameters_policy: Provider defaults; record actual request parameters
llm.temperature_policy: Send temperature0 as frozen pilot; user accepts providers which ignore/do not support it

pricing.cost: usage.cost for each unique new request; unknown cost pauses

scientific_metric: LangPro prediction agreement with gold; never KB F1
selection: Exact input tuples in all four historical Table4 exports, original WordNet-only order; no subset restriction

controlled_variables: initial prompt and its required parser
controlled_comparison.common: Exact 1000 inputs, filtering, critic/refinement, baseline eligibility and gold stop, Ter/Lim guard, RAL200 flags, at most2 KB attempts
controlled_comparison.baseline_policy: Fresh common WN on/off requests unless exact compatible journal exists; cache shared globally across models/prompts/configurations

source_components: Reuse verified immutable experiments/c5_exact223_stefan snapshots and pilot_support; initial LEX template identical to lex_agentic_pilot
